items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps oily, breakout-prone skin clean without stripping it.
A gentle leave-on cream that helps with the look of blemishes and uneven redness without harsh actives.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier, as moisture scores are on the lower side.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin during the day and suits sensitive, redness-prone skin.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, apply the azelaic cream after the evening cleanse, then moisturize, and finish with the mineral SPF in the morning. Since breakouts feel severe during pregnancy, please ask your prenatal provider or a dermatologist before adding any benzoyl peroxide wash, rather than starting with the strongest one.
